description: Angular component for managing a list of entity keys with autocomplete, input, and removal functionalities, used within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: EntityKeysListComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing and displaying a list of entity keys with autocomplete and chip input features.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form control.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the control is touched (not implemented).

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the filteredKeys observable for autocomplete.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Lifecycle hook after view initialization (empty implementation).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form group based on the disabled state.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the current value of the component.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updates validity if dirty.

methods.name: addKey
methods.description: Adds a new key to the list if not already present.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles adding a key via chip input event.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the list.

methods.name: displayKeyFn
methods.description: Returns display string for a key.

methods.name: fetchKeys
methods.description: Fetches entity keys matching search text from the entity service.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the input field and optionally emits an event.
